title: They look like mardi gras beads
text: They look like mardi gras beads. Big disappointment on this item.  The beads are not copper and burgundy.  They are more more purple than burgundy. The lighter color looks the same as the picture but the darker color doesn't look anything like the picture.  If you want a purple Christmas, these are for you. Oh and they are iridescent which is kind of pretty but they don't look iridescent in the picture.

product_metadata.title: Kurt Adler 9' Burgundy & Copper Twisted Metallic Beaded Christmas Garland #H9743
